answer: In a market funding garden robots that measure meadow nectar, divide a fixed reward pool in proportion to locked capital, with no bonus or minimum payout per key. Validators sum each key's escrow and enforce exact proportional accounting; splitting one stake across a thousand aliases leaves its combined reward unchanged. Buying more influence requires more capital and its borrowing or opportunity cost, even in parallel. This assumes enforceable locks and no rounding loopholes. Wealthy colluders can dominate, while newcomers may start with small stakes.
